lin: Quick flag 1: new reranker-v3 PTQ smoke is showing -0.031 NDCG@10 / -0.012 MRR@10 vs FP16 on the nightly holdout. No weight changes, but we did change ingest: replaced two-newline join with '<JOIN>' and inserted a 40-token __PRIME_PAD__ block in templates.

harper: Did you run a formatting parity check? small whitespace/sep changes often explain this.

lin: Not initially. Running controlled probes now: A) baseline v3-int8 as-is, B) revert join to '\n\n' at eval time, C) strip __PRIME_PAD__ before tokenization, D) both. Command: `./scripts/eval_smoke.py --model rerank-v3-int8 --holdout nightly-30k --k 10`.

sam: Also dump the tokenizer length histogram and per-query deltas. `python tools/seq_hist.py --input holdout.jsonl --tokenizer reranker-v3` and `./tools/ndcg_diff --a=fp16.csv --b=int8.csv`.

eval-bot: Started job 132477. Artifacts: https://console.redwood/jobs/132477. ETA ~18m.

lin: Results: B recovered +0.022 NDCG, C recovered +0.008, D recovered +0.030 (nearly eliminates gap). MRR trends similar. Seq hist shows mean tokens +4.8% with new ingest, 95th +10%.

harper: So formatting/distribution-shift is dominant. Action: add a preproc parity step to the PTQ bringup checklist, and a seqlen drift alert in the quant pipeline (alert if mean or 95th change >5%).

sam: Also propose small harness change: when promoting INT8, run a normalized-pipeline diff (FP16 vs INT8 with identical normalized inputs) and assert NDCG@10 delta <= 0.01 on smoke holdout.

lin: Filed INF-3012: "reranker-v3: ingest parity + seqlen guardrails" with repro scripts and artifacts. Pushed tiny normalizer to the bringup branch.

harper: Thanks. One more follow-up: add a note to model-card about priming pad tokens and delimiter semantics. We've tripped on this across multiple bringups.

lin: Will do, and will re-run full PTQ pipeline after patch. Leaving artifacts and per-query csv in job 132477. Ping me for slices. :white_check_mark:
